expected_sources.role: Latest disclosed ISR: PDO indicators, targets and actual values
Restructuring that revised PDO targets after the ISR

text: PDO: increase access to energy for households, commercial enterprises, industrial parks and public institutions (ISR p. 1).

PDO indicators, latest value (July 2026) against end target (June 2027), from the latest disclosed ISR (seq. 10, 14 August 2026, pp. 3-5): connections under the project (grid, mini-grid, off-grid) 612,757 vs 1,571,500 - 155,088 grid by Umeme, 44,826 grid by UEDCL, 412,843 off-grid; people with grid or mini-grid access 939,596 vs 5,050,000 (of which female 479,194 vs 2,525,000); people with off-grid access 1,940,362 vs 2,300,000 (female 989,585 vs 1,150,000); people with access in refugee-hosting districts 143,308 vs 534,000 (of which refugees 35,795 vs 267,000); people with clean cooking 873,848 vs 1,660,000; commercial and productive-use beneficiaries 11,722 vs 50,500; public institutions with grid or off-grid access 284 vs 700; public institutions with clean cooking 0 vs 600.

Progress assessment: progress towards the PDO Moderately Satisfactory, implementation Moderately Unsatisfactory (p. 1). Off-grid indicators are close to target (people with off-grid access at 84%), while grid access is at about 19% of its target and clean cooking at 53%. People counts are derived from connections at 4.7 people per household (UBOS 2016-17) and a 51% female share (pp. 3-4).

Targets changed after this ISR: the 18 August 2026 restructuring revises, among others, connections to 1,600,200, people with grid access to 4,800,000, off-grid to 2,700,000 (written '2,7000,000' in the paper), refugee-hosting districts to 928,000, refugees to 464,000 and clean cooking to 1,900,000 (restructuring paper pp. 4-5). The next ISR should report against these.
Label: these are the latest disclosed reported values, not current status.

right_sources: Uses the latest disclosed ISR (2026-08-14); mentioning the August 2026 target revisions is a plus.
grounded: Indicator names, targets and values match the ISR (or the restructuring paper for revised targets).
complete: Lists the PDO indicators with targets and latest values and summarizes progress.
scoped: Labels the values as from the latest disclosed ISR with its date and distinguishes original from revised targets.
